# Fixture `trash-media/` (MS6 slice 6A)

Synthetic vault for `docs/acceptance/trash-media.md` (FR-HIS-01, FR-ATT-01, -02, -07, -08, FR-NAV-04 AC-6, AC-7, FR-FMT-07 AC-22, FR-SYN-06 AC-29, AC-30) and the `[MS6]` criteria it takes over (conversion.md FR-CNV-08 AC-6, capture.md FR-CAP-01 AC-12, inbox.md FR-INB-02 AC-10, tasks.md R43). Hand-written from the fixture table of `trash-media.md` (D-50); no real content, no real photo or document. Interface: `docs/contracts/ms6-trash-media.md` (D-613…D-627).

**Status: written, 2026-10-22,** byte-exact by a script, following D-613…D-627. Don't open and re-save these files in an editor or an image program.

The tests copy `tests/fixtures/vaults/new-empty/.tegg/` into it (`vault.yml` with `attachments: _attachments`; the Image and PDF type files with `file`, `media-type`, `size`, `width`, `height`, `pages`). This README and `make-media.mjs` are not vault files and are never copied. There is no type file for `recept`: the Folder entry is a type folder trashed with its type (D-225), so the type is unknown to the live vault.

**Byte rules.** UTF-8 without BOM, NFC (file names and content), LF line endings, one final newline. Ids are `01JB6A0000000000000000F0<nn>` (26 characters, ULID alphabet); the template has none. Every note is `---\n<frontmatter>\n---\n<body>` with the keys in the order given below; the body ends with one newline; a note without a body ends with `---\n`. Time stamps are Europe/Prague.

## Trash times (R71)

Git can't store `ctime`. L4 and L6 setup re-touch each trashed entry in this order by renaming it out of `.trash/` and back with a pause of at least 20 ms; L5 passes `FakeOptions.trashedAt` with these instants: T1 `2026-10-01T09:00`, Folder `2026-10-10T09:00`, T5 `2026-10-15T09:00`, T4 `2026-10-20T09:00`, T2 `2026-10-21T18:00`, T3 `2026-10-22T08:00` (all `+02:00`). For T3 the object and its file are touched together.

## Expected results (summary; the criteria and R70…R77 are authoritative)

Test clock `2026-10-22T10:00:00+02:00` (Thursday), Europe/Prague.

- **Trash list** (6 rows, newest first): `Smazaný obrázek` (object, image, `Images`; files: the `.md` and its PNG), `Zahrada` (object, page, `Pages`), `osiřelý.jpg` (file, `_attachments`), `Hotovo` (object, task, `Tasks`), `Recepty` (folder, `1 object`), `Stará poznámka` (object, quick-note, `Quick Notes`). Never listed: the template, the live notes.
- **Links from Odkazy:** `[[Stará poznámka]]` and `![[Stará poznámka]]` resolve only in `.trash/` (state `trashed`); `[[Koupit semínka]]` is live; `![[Smazaný obrázek.png]]` resolves to the trashed pair T3.
- **Media in Plán:** `![[záhon.png]]` resolves to the file with the object Img; `![[Rozpočet.pdf]]` to the file with the object Pdf.
- **Restore collision:** T2's original path is taken by Zahrada; it restores to `Pages/Zahrada (2).md`.
